gap: No result ChatGPT got states that ChatGPT's own top pick, the BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 + 200 W kit (shown at $699), costs $729.00 at BLUETTI's store today ($692.55 through our link) and is a pre-order that dispatches in mid-December 2026. In the 1,000–1,800 W class, the cheapest kit with the most panels that ships now at the same 1,024 Wh is the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 600 W kit at $718.20 ($0.70/Wh), which has three times the panel watts.
standout_why: Compared against the cited StormWatts (Nov 8, updated Nov 12), Trek4Tech (updated Nov 9) and SolutionEnergy (Nov 8) pages. TheOutageReady's page (theoutageplan.com) would not load because of a TLS certificate error. StormWatts is the strongest rival: it has dated prices, $/kWh and some shipping states. But it lists the Elite 100 V2 + 200 W at $699 with no shipping note, gives no AC output, and includes no ALLPOWERS kit. Trek4Tech gives no prices or dates at all; it only links live Amazon listings. SolutionEnergy gives no kit prices and no shipping states. None of the three says that the Elite 100 V2 kit is a pre-order or that Anker's own store ships the C1000 Gen 2 kit in early December. None says that EcoFlow's 220 W variant of the DELTA 3 kit cannot be bought today.
decides: This changes the pick. The kit both ChatGPT chats called 'best value' cannot be in hand before mid-December, and the Anker alternative ships in early December from Anker's store. The Anker is also 2,000 W, which is above the 1,000 W class line of 1,000–1,800 W. Among kits that ship now with 1,024 Wh and 1,800 W, the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 600 W at $718.20 through our link leads on panel watts at nearly the same $/Wh (5.1 h at rated output for 200 W panels vs 1.7 h for 600 W; the P1800's solar input limit is unverified). The EcoFlow DELTA 3 + 110 W at $729 ships now but has a smaller panel (9.3 h). The Elite 100 V2 + 200 W stays the pick for a shopper who can wait until mid-December.

Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 (Explorer 1000 v2 + 200 W)

Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 + 200 W (outside the AC line at 2,000 W)
